own_solution.law: Conservation of angular momentum about the axle (I1 w0 = (I1+I2) w); heat Q = (1/2) I1 w0^2 - (1/2)(I1+I2) w^2 = (1/2) [I1 I2/(I1+I2)] w0^2
assumptions: second disc initially at rest, frictionless axle so no external torque about the axle

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T3181 and T1AC4 state the ring's moment of inertia as 'a small amount' rather than 0.04 kg*m^2 as in their apparent counterparts TE735 and T7B9A, so if they are meant as variants they do not state the same number and unit; this reads as an unnatural non-numeric rendering.

notes: With ring glued (I2 = 0.07 kg*m^2): Q = 0.5*(0.04*0.07/0.11)*3947.84 = 50.25 J. Friction torque only sets the slip time; the dissipated energy is fixed by angular momentum conservation, so it cancels (C). Grinding-wheel ring and the 'earlier run only' ring have no path to the target. Initial KE 78.96 J; final KE 45.12 J. Whether the 'small amount' sentences are intended as a separate value of the quantity will be checked in pass 2.
